## conveyor.start
Entry: fr's conveyor start webhook (backend/src/services/conveyor-start-webhook.ts) POSTs /webhook/conveyor-start once per new project, after its RM project and Planka board exist. Header auth X-Conveyor-Token (credential "fr conveyor start"), header Idempotency-Key, body exactly {event:"project.created", rm_project_id, tenant_id, fr_project_id}.
Not a card-type flow: no card type, no capability, no agents. It births the project's first card, project_start_request_analysis, in TODO and moves it to READY itself: it is a structural card (no WIP slot), and the move fires its READY flow.

## How it works
1. Validate: event == project.created, rm_project_id and Idempotency-Key present, else 400 invalid_start_request. A restart (R349) is {scope:'project'} (target phase setup) or {scope:'phase', phase, comment?} (comment <= 2000 chars), else 400 restart_invalid.
2. Get project (RM getProject, conveyor tenant): 404 -> 409 project_mismatch; other RM failure -> 503 (fr retries). tenant_id differs -> 409 tenant_mismatch; fr_project_id differs from origin_project_id -> 409 project_mismatch; no restart and current_phase != setup -> 409 phase_not_setup; no planka_board_id / TODO / READY list id -> 409 project_mismatch.
3. Get board (one Planka board get: cards + custom field values). Restart? no: a project_start_request_analysis card still in TODO -> Resume? -> step 5, answer 200 {accepted, resumed}; one anywhere else -> 409 psra_exists. That check IS the idempotency: a repeated POST finds the card.
3r. Restart? yes: Project type -> Restart plan (target not a type phase or after current_phase -> 409 restart_phase_invalid) -> Archive card: every card of the target phase or a later one (scope project: every card) goes to the board's Planka archive list (no flow fires) -> Set phase (RM, restart, compare-and-set on the current phase) -> Restart card (setup: project_start_request_analysis, else project_phase_start; {card_type, phase}; comment under 'Steering comment (restart)').
4. Otherwise Create card "Project start request analysis" in TODO -> Set card fields {card_type: project_start_request_analysis, phase} -> Created.
5. Move to READY -> Moved (the card must be in READY) -> 200 {accepted:true} (fresh), {accepted, resumed} or {accepted, restarted, phase}. The move fires the card's READY flow; wip.pull then finds nothing in TODO to pull.

## Gates and exit
Gates: Valid?, Project ok?, Create?, Resume?; Route answer picks the reply.
Answers: 200 {accepted} | 200 {accepted, resumed} | 400 {code} | 409 {code in project_mismatch, tenant_mismatch, phase_not_setup, psra_exists} | 503 start_unavailable. A 200 is sent only after the card exists with its card_type AND is in READY; a failed create or move fails the run (n8n answers 5xx, fr retries with the same key and the retry finds the card in TODO and moves it).
A restart is not idempotent: a retried restart archives the previous restart card and creates a new one; a Set phase 409 after archiving answers 5xx and the fr retry converges.
Exit: the start card is in READY; nothing else is written.
